notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.3 (SCANNER MISTAKES FIX + BRIDGE OVERHAUL)
notes.content:
📦 Update 1.0.3 - Scanner mistakes fix & bridge improvements! 📦
Hey Parcel Inspectors! This update brings some heavily requested fixes from the community: fixes to scanners causing mistakes in fully automated setups, and reducing bottlenecks caused by bridge conveyors. This update is a little light, but fixing these bugs has been an absolute nightmare to be honest! Now that the super nasty and time consuming issues are out of the way, I'm hoping to have 1.0.4 out within the next couple of weeks along with some new content!


🔍 Scanner Mistakes Fix
For those unaware, there has been an intermittent issue present which caused a very small number of parcels to be incorrectly scanned by scanners, causing mistakes to be output even with fully automated setups. This was an incredibly nasty bug to fix, as finding a consistent way to reproduce the issue was near-impossible. Thanks to help from the Discord community I was able to find a repro, and fix this problem. If you're still finding this issue is present do reach out, but hopefully now it should be resolved!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44147245/a05c2d73bfbc99a5e5e5a2283e95284e56c3bf41.jpg"]
🌉 Bridger Conveyor Improvements
Bridger conveyors have been a pain-point for many players as they have failed to queue up parcels in the same way that straight or corner conveyors do, instead behaving like one single long conveyor. This has now been changed such that parcels will queue up along the bridge.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44147245/762c17884d3a518620b679f6823cbc47b5479ec6.jpg"]

I also saw from the community that bridges were getting "stuck" after loading in from a save, or starting a new day, meaning you had to constantly go around unblocking stuck bridges. This should hopefully also now be resolved, as bridge conveyors have more sensibly colliders across their full length, rather than just at the top.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44147245/2fd2c56afdc3b4f20df56247820a8c6a34b67ee3.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]

🛠️ Fixes
MAJOR: Fixed the issue where scanners incorrectly validated parcels sometimes, causing mistakes to be output in fully automated setups

Bridges now behave as if they are 3 separate pieces, allowing parcels to traverse them in the same way that parcels navigate straight/corner conveyors

Fixed bridges getting stuck after loading from save by adding new colliders across the full length of them

Added missing arrows to contents diverter conveyor
🤏 Tweaks
Added missing string into Korean translation

Added tweaks to various translations

Small change to improve stability on some systems


[hr][/hr]

❤️ Thank you for 1400+ Steam Reviews!
As always, thanks for leaving a Steam review! They help a lot with understanding the pain-points in the game, as well as showing the game to more players on Steam. Though I do not respond to all messages in the Steam Discussions, I am reading as much as I can and am using the feedback to improve the game and shape future updates - thank you for your continued support!


📅 Up Next
There a few outstanding bugs I'm looking to sort, namely joiner conveyors getting stuck, loaders being slow and sometimes causing infinite load/unload bugs with storage racks, and implementing a more robust save game backup system. 

I'm also hoping to add some new stuff in the next update. Not sure what exactly that will be just yet, but hopefully something fun!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.2 (MULTI JOINER + 4 NEW LANGUAGES)
notes.content:
📦 Update 1.0.2 - Multi Joiner, 4 New Languages, and More! 📦
Hey Parcel Inspectors! Thanks for your patience on this update, I've had a few IRL roadblocks over the last few weeks that have held me back, but I'm now back up and running and working on updates! This update brings some bug fixes and some small bits of new content, namely the Multi Joiner Conveyor, additional levels for the Conveyor Deliveries upgrade, and translation into four new languages!


🌐 Languages Update
Parcel Simulator now supports 11 languages! Here is the full list so far, including the 4 new languages:

English

German

French

Spanish

Polish

Simplified Chinese

Portuguese - Brazil

➕ Italian

➕ Japanese

➕ Korean

➕ Russian

More languages may come soon, feel free to reach out if there are any you wish to see in the game!


🆕 Multi-Joiner Conveyor
A request that I keep seeing come up is the need to combine more than two streams of parcels together via a joiner, or for two opposing sides to be joined together. The Multi Joiner now allows for this, and can be purchased in the shop.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44147245/46308a796495c78da2115f3c7b15043c94758b68.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44147245/623ad06d35db91b056b8968ae15671607a14dbe3.png"]
⤴️ Conveyor Deliveries Upgrade
Until now, the conveyor belts in the delivery doors have not been upgradable. To make the process of upgrading these belts simpler, I've added two new tiers to the "Conveyor Deliveries" upgrade, in the Upgrades tab, which increments all belts in all delivery doors to levels 2 and 3 when upgraded.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44147245/59f07fadee93909e03f26235c434ee5574f03c2e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44147245/de6e73a00e4a965dd5d9ea6dc8ff06388179669d.png"]
📦 Pallets Should Now Save Correctly
Pretty simple, Pallets should now save the parcels and shop deliveries that are attached to them after sleeping or exiting the game!


[hr][/hr]

✨ Features
Added a new "Multi Joiner" conveyor belt, which joins three streams of parcels into one.

Added two new tiers to the "Conveyor Deliveries" upgrade, allowing delivery door belts to be upgraded to levels 2 & 3

Parcels and shop deliveries now save to pallets when sleeping or exiting the game

Added support for four new community-requested languages: Italian, Japanese, Korean and Russian
🛠️ Fixes
Fixed the "N/A criteria invalid" bug - thanks @Yangster for providing reproduction steps for this one!

Added missing ceiling and wall pieces into later warehouse tier bays

Fixed collisions under delivery doors which caused small parcels to get stuck under the doors, blocking conveyors from moving

Fixed missing translations in various languages

Parcels now spawn directly on conveyor belts in delivery bays, more sensibly spaced apart, to prevent the physics system from forcing them to be thrown around in the delivery bays

Fixed font/UI scaling issues on the tablet for certain languages with longer character lengths

Added missing directional arrows to sticker checker conveyors

Allowed contents inspection diverter conveyors to be painted
🤏 Tweaks
Added better support for CJK characters


[hr][/hr]

❤️ Thank you for 1000+ Steam Reviews!
Thank you so much for getting Parcel Simulator to over 1000+ reviews on Steam! I appreciate you taking the time to leave a review, it means a lot to me and helps me understand where the pain-points are in the game. All of the feedback, through both Steam reviews and the various feedback channels/forums, is being processed and will be used to organise future updates.


📅 Up Next
I'm still investigating the bug which causes parcels to sometimes be incorrectly categorised by scanners, or being pre-approved/denied incorrectly. If anyone has consistent reproduction steps, please let me know below or send a message in the Discord server! I appreciate this is a super annoying one, but I am working on it!

I'm also hoping to have the bridges operating a bit more nicely in the next update, such that they behave like three conveyor pieces rather than just one.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.1
notes.content:
📦 Update 1.0.1 📦
Hey Parcel Inspectors! It's now been just over two weeks since launch and so I thought I'd drop an update with some of the fixes and improvements that have been implemented so far. Some more exciting stuff is coming soon, but for now I'm trying to get all the key issues and bugs ironed out.


✨ Features
Added directional arrows to joiner, diverter, and splitter conveyors to better indicate the in/out directions during placement

Stamps on envelope parcels now appear on the front, next to the weight class, rather than on the back of the parcel to make it clearer that these parcels do have Stamps

Added a toast notification which warns of the required warehouse tier when trying to upgrade belts without the correct tier unlocked

Added a "Q" hotkey icon next to "Pick up" when hovering over items that can be repacked
🛠️ Fixes
Fixed an issue where sometimes conveyor belts and machines would fall through the floor when dropped with right mouse button

Fixed contracts requirements sometimes asking for parcels of a specific country, but the description incorrectly asking for the inverse

Improved collisions in the inbound delivery doors to make it harder to get stuck

Improved collisions at the edge of the inbound delivery doors to prevent small envelope parcels falling through an invisible gap

Added some improvements to prevent pallets being pushed through the floor when opening attached delivery parcels

When selling shop deliveries while attached to a pallet, correctly remove their references so you can continue to use the pallet as normal

Allow parcels stuck inside/under the entrance to chutes to be picked up
🤏 Tweaks
Various translation updates and tweaks

Improved strange scaling on serial number keypad header in certain languages

Fixed a typo in the welcome email


❤️ Thank you for 500+ Steam Reviews!
I wanted to say thank you for helping the game reach over 500 reviews on Steam! This is a huge milestone and really helps the game reach a wider audience across Steam. Thank you for taking the time to leave a review, and for sharing your feedback and thoughts on the game. I've been reading every review and making sure to note any complaints in order to better shape future updates.


📅 Up Next
I'm currently investigating a few key issues, including pallets not correctly saving attached parcels, and scanners intermittently and inconsistently making mistakes (even in fully automated setups). I hope to have these issues fixed soon and will post a community update as and when they are.

Thanks for all the bug reports via the in-game reporting tool, the Steam Community Hub, and on Discord. There is a lot of great feedback, so please bear with me while I work my way through it all. I'm picking out the most requested/important items and working to proritise those requests as quickly as I can!

New content updates coming soon!

notes.title: Devlog #002 - May 2025
notes.content:
Hey Parcel Inspectors!

It's been a busy month for Parcel Simulator, with lots of new features and changes being worked on to get the game closer to release. I'm hoping to have a release date announcement coming very soon. Here's some of the stuff I've been working on:

📈 The Warehouse Must Expand!
The non-demo area of the warehouse has been expanded significantly, with many more expansions and lots more verticality for extra large storage racks. More space is something I hear demo players crave, so I've made sure that the full release warehouse has lots of expansions to build your conveyor setups into!

https://i.imgur.com/0jzuXSg.gif

↗️ Splitter Conveyor
The splitter conveyor will allow you to equally split parcels three ways to split up your storage. The splitter always prioritises empty routes, so even if one or more of the routes are full parcels will continue to flow.

https://i.imgur.com/Luzh6tf.gif

🤑 Conveyor Upgrades
The conveyor upgrade system has been implemented to allow you to upgrade existing conveyors to level 2 and level 3, increasing speed and other stats. Scanners can be upgraded to increase their scan speed, and conveyors upgraded to increase their movement speed.

https://i.imgur.com/kTdGXCG.gif

🔎 Contents Inspection Improvements
Further improvements have been made to the contents inspection licence in Parcel Simulator, including some better animations, a larger variety of items, and some QOL changes.

https://i.imgur.com/m474wOd.gif

🔢 Serial Number Improvements
To make life easier when checking serial numbers, some invalid serial numbers will now be visually identifiable by looking for codes that are too short, or contain alphabetic characters (A-Z). The handheld serial number scanner has also been improved, to allow back-to-back scanning of packages to check for validity.

https://i.imgur.com/vhiDbIN.gif

🎨 Conveyor Paint
Conveyor belt paint will allow you to paint up to 10 belts per bucket, to make your conveyors more visually distinct from one another. 🔴🟠🟡🟢🔵🟣

https://i.imgur.com/Rd1fbiP.gif

💾 Autosave
Autosave will be enabled by default, ensuring that your game saves as you play. You'll be able to disable this in the settings, though, if you want to ensure that Alt+F4 doesn't save your progress.

https://i.imgur.com/cZsF0KN.gif

---

Also, thank you all for posting in the Steam discussions, reporting bugs using the in-game reporting tool (F7), and for posting on Discord - I make sure I try to read every single bug report!

Thanks all again for the support!
-- Dan

notes.title: Devlog #001 - April 2025
notes.content:
Hey Parcel Inspectors!

First of all, thank you so much for the support on the Demo! Since releasing 6 weeks ago, the Demo has been played by over 30,000 unique players and the game has reached over 28,000 wishlists! The support is much appreciated, and I can't wait for you all to play the full release soon. Here is some of the stuff I've been working on for Parcel Simulator:

🏗️ Larger Storage
Three tiers of storage will be available: small, medium and large. This is a preview of one of the larger storage racks, allowing you to scale your storage and operations vertically.

https://i.imgur.com/YTTnpwM.gif

🎛️ Key Remapping
This has been a highly requested feature, for those using international keyboard layouts or simply wanting to modify the default controls. You'll be able to rebind almost all of the available controls in the game, including movement controls, pickup/placement controls, and controls at the inspection table.

https://i.imgur.com/IkBvQzU.gif

🔎 Contents Inspection
Still a work-in-progress, but this is a sneak-peek at part of the contents inspection system coming to Parcel Simulator. Inspecting contents is something that will be required for a small portion (around 5-10%) of parcels, indicated by a large red sticker on the parcels. You'll have to check packages for prohibited items, and approve/deny accordingly.

https://i.imgur.com/LQ5Z0iM.gif

🏪 Repack Items into Boxes
Another highly requested feature is the ability to repack items back into their shop delivery boxes. This is a nice QOL change which will allow you to rework your conveyor setups more easily as you'll be able to pickup 4 conveyor boxes at once with the pallet. Further down the line, this will also tie into the ability to resell items back to the shop, at a discounted rate, so that you can do something with no longer useful items.

https://i.imgur.com/2lFgaQI.gif

⚙️ Automatic Exports Upgrade
One of the new upgrades that will be available in the full release is "Automatic Exports". As the name suggests, this will automatically submit export doors when they reach maximum capacity, meaning you won't have to click the export button to "unclog" stuck conveyor systems.

https://i.imgur.com/MdjwzMJ.gif

🐛 Bug Fixes and Tweaks
Thank you all for reporting bugs and issues via the F7 in-game reporting tool, and via Discord. As with every update, lots of bugs have been fixed and tweaks have been made to make Parcel Simulator an even more polished experience.


Once again, thank you for the support!
-- Dan
